Book recommendation of the week: Stations, by Louise Kennedy. After a young Irish woman falls into an intense, complicated friendship with a troubled boy, their lives continue to intersect over the next 25 years. First love, complicated families, bad decisions, the way we can spend years longing for people after they’re out of our lives … it’s so good. (Amazon, Bookshop)
